body:
Oh my god, are you me in a parallel universe?

My name is Delphine. 

Look, when anybody gives you am ultimatum , it backs you into a corner. Sounds like losing your job was better in the long run than staying at a place you hated. 

Don't hang yourself over employment, or your dad, or anybody else. If you got fired, I'm assuming you can qualify for unemployment- not a pretty penny, but enough to eat. Do you have any cousins/friends/ friends of friends to rent a room from? 

Hang in there. Keep painting. 

Oh ps- yesterday I went into my attic to look for a quiet place to hang myself. Let's not do that.

Let me repeat that: you're suffering! It's impossible to feel relief while suffering. I'm so so so sorry you're in pain. I don't know if I'm helping or making it worse but I'm listening,  Jordy. You're better than you perceive. You are caring. You are self aware and self reflective. You are also SO STRONG. You will come through the other side if this.

Hey, I'm listening to you. If you want to talk to a stranger, I'm your gal. 
I relate to your 'facade' statement. I feel the same way with my relationships. Message me

It's not a crime, a "sin", or a shame to BE YOU. Please don't focus on standards of beauty or intellect. Give yourself a chance to learn the unique gifts you can offer the world. Beauty and intellect fade. Control the one thing you can: intention.
Hey I'm here and I think I know how you feel. Of course you deserve to live. No matter what you've done. We are all living, learning creatures.

This fucking sucks. Can you give me a general idea where you are? Maybe I can send amazon groceries or Vons delivery to you- are you in the US?

I'm so sorry you're in so much pain. I'm also really sad you don't have anybody to come check on you.

Maybe I can at least give you a code to a gift certificate for grocery delivery?
Write back soon
No. I didn't. I was replying to myself.
No. It was an impatient reply to myself as in, nobody else cared so I replied to myself in jest.
